purpose: Teach: アンプ/エンタープライズ/タイムズ/バーツ/カンパニー/キーパー/エコノミスト/ウィルコム

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、会議室のアンプ、つまり音響装置を更新しろ
lines.en: Update the audio equipment in our conference rooms.
lines.style: Clipped, direct authority. No softening. Sharp attack on the imperative verb. Measured pace — each phrase lands with weight. Eyes forward, not seeking agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新拠点をエンタープライズ拠点として位置付けます
lines.en: Understood. I'll position the new site as an enterprise hub.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment with quiet confidence. Even delivery, slightly faster than the boss — showing readiness. Respectful but not deferential. Direct eye contact held.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外のタイムズ系新聞に広告を出せ
lines.en: Place advertisements with the Times media group overseas.
lines.style: Same crisp authority as the first directive. Slightly less pause between clauses. The tone of someone who expects execution, not discussion. Composed, decisive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。タイの取引でバーツ建ての契約を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll finalize the Thai contracts in baht denominations.
lines.style: Slightly faster tempo than before — showing momentum. Confident nod of the head as he speaks. The efficiency of someone who has already begun thinking through logistics.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外子会社、つまりカンパニーとの連携を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our coordination with overseas subsidiary companies.
lines.style: The same measured clip as directives one and three. No repeat of phrasing — variation shows mastery of authority, not reliance on a script. Slight emphasis on 'strengthen' — the expectation is clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内データのキーパー、つまり保管担当を明確化します
lines.en: Understood. I'll clarify the data management chain of custody.
lines.style: Same steady, responsive pace. A fraction more focused than previous acknowledgments — this task is slightly more complex. Still composed, still forward-moving. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、エコノミスト誌の特集記事を経営陣で読み合わせろ
lines.en: Have the executive team read through that Economist feature article together.
lines.style: Softer than the operational directives. This one carries subtext — cultural alignment, not just logistics. Slight warmth underneath. The pause suggests he's thought about why this matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。旧サービスのウィルコム端末の取り扱いを整理します
lines.en: Understood. I'll consolidate our legacy WILLCOM device support protocols.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment — slightly extended, showing completion. A touch of finality without abruptness. Respectful closure. Slight nod downward as he speaks, readiness to execute and move on.
